import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['.venv/bin/python3', '-m', 'pytest', '-q',
     'tests/test_issue_reconciliation_dossier.py',
     'tests/test_triage_decision_writer.py',
     'tests/test_issue_record_writer.py',
     'tests/test_issue_state_transition.py',
     'tests/test_workflow_ledger_verify.py',
     'tests/test_improvement_candidate_writer.py'],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
)
print('exit', result.returncode)
print(result.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1].rsplit(' in ', 1)[0])
